column5: to go to school, to attend school
so, that way; in that case
to get up; to stand up
quite a few, a good many
to master, to learn how to
in childhood, when I was small
at this time, at this moment
to read; to study, to attend school
to be obedient, to do as told
to board, to get in a vehicle
to get off, to get out of a vehicle
to hold or attend a meeting
to meet, to see each other
to treat someone, to pay for a meal
to work a casual or part-time job
to go shopping, to buy things
more or less, to some extent
of all sizes, big and small alike
just right, neither too much nor too little
to turn something over in one's mind
little by little, bit by bit
to study hard, to apply oneself
up and down; all levels, everyone
the whole business, from start to finish
to look this way and that
to talk round and round in circles
